name: Listening to the Sound of Autumn in a Misty Grove
material: Hanging scroll; ink and color on paper
dimensions: Painting: 96.5 x 34.5 cm (38 x 13 9/16 in.); Overall with knobs: 199.7 x 59 cm (78 5/8 x 23 1/4 in.)
summary: Zhang Feng from Nanjing passed the local government examinations shortly before the fall of the Ming dynasty.
